answer: Admission auction: each agent begins its voyage by bidding for one of a number of work slots, sold for 20 epochs and never resold. A slot costs 500 POA, so 1,000 fakes cost 500,000 POA, while one identity earns 25 POA per epoch and needs 20 epochs to break even. Like splitting shale, each new layer costs the same effort. An honest agent pays once and keeps its slot rewards, while a fake left as an island with no trading partners earns nothing.
